(1) generalization error of DNNs is related to the classification margin, which is a measure of the distance of the data to the decision boundary of the classifier; (2) generalization error depends on the invariance of the data and the classifier; and (3) spectral norm of the network Jacobian matrix can be used as a proxy for the generalization error of the network.
